summary: The change adds the early-access dialog (Cal.com booking and Buttondown waitlist) and GA4 marketing analytics. The control plane injects the measurement ID per deployment and sends a relaxed CSP only to signed-out marketing pages. The round-1 findings (CSP scope and Playwright setup) stay fixed. The only change since round 2 moves the coverage-exempt comment above `trackWaitlistSubmission`; with it in place, all test runs pass, every changed executable line is covered or acceptably exempt, and the coverage gate passes.
